what: The Myrvold-Woodcock collection of torus obstructions, and the comparison with T1,...,T74. Each line of the collection is n followed by the upper triangle of the adjacency matrix, row by row; entries are numbered from 1. For each of T1,...,T73, the entry it equals and an isomorphism from T_i (vertex numbers as in O1) onto that entry. T74 is not in the collection.

source.page: https://webhome.cs.uvic.ca/~wendym/torus/torus_obstructions.html (revised August 16, 2017; "All minor order obstructions known so far", 17535 graphs)
source.paper: W. Myrvold and J. Woodcock, A large set of torus obstructions and how they were discovered, Electron. J. Combin. 25 (2018), P1.16

check: The canonical form of T74 is not among the canonical forms of the 17,535 entries, and for each of T1,...,T73 the canonical form equals that of the entry it is matched to. nauty 2.8.8, labelg (graph6 of the canonically labelled graph).
